direction: The owner liked the shape studies and requested continuing the local material work.
scope: The two local review exteriors. No game replacement or paid provider generation.
method: Freeze the mesh, camera, exposure and lighting. Compare median encoded sRGB within paired patches. Weight their RGB by 0.2126, 0.7152, 0.0722 on a 0–255 display scale. Average absolute per-mark deviations; these do not measure physical reflectance or the entire ship.
lighting: Default studio from the shape record, 24 Cycles samples. The key turns 65 degrees about world Z. The unlit control blacks out the world and disables every scene light.

glacier-tongue.name: Glacier Tongue

emissive_materials: Glacier · brushed silver, indigo and cabin glazing

glacier-tongue.limit: The eight glazing marks still average 65.0 brightness units against 53.5 in the painting. The hidden blade face uses a physically shaded neutral titanium finish.

delta-tree.name: Delta Tree
delta-tree.limit: The floors follow the accepted sheet. The 15 of 16 floor alignment from the prior pass limits boundary agreement, particularly where the narrow port rib crosses a mark.

delivery.viewer: Both models rotate, reset, switch revision and download in isolated headless Chrome.
